title: MPESB ADDET Answer Key 2026
postName: ADDET (related MPESB recruitment examination) Answer Key 2026
vacancyDetails: Model / provisional answer key for MPESB ADDET examination as published on ESB portal
qualification: As per MPESB ADDET official advertisement
selectionProcess: Written / CBT → Further stages as per board
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://esb.mp.gov.in
2. Open Model Answer / Question Objection section
3. Select ADDET 2026 answer key link
4. Login with application credentials if required
5. Download key and raise objections within schedule
shortDescription: MPESB ADDET Answer Key 2026 – download model answers and raise objections from esb.mp.gov.in when link is active.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) publishes model answer keys for its recruitment exams including ADDET on the official portal.

Candidates should log in at esb.mp.gov.in, download the answer key / response sheet, and submit objections (if any) within the board’s prescribed window before the final key and result.
